symptom: A stable product release passed publication and consumer readback, but every updater facade rejected its embedded Runtime Bootstrap before check because trustedKeys[].key was emitted as a numeric array instead of the schema-required base64 string.
whyGateMissed: The control-plane model validated raw key bytes and the facade tests used hand-written schema-conforming JSON; no gate serialized the generated control-plane document and parsed those exact bytes through a public SDK.
earliestDetection: Immediately after resolution, serialize the generated Runtime Bootstrap and require the public facade SDK to parse it before any host artifact is built.
